answer: Problem: operators park cheap keys along a scoring ridge so one basalt-grade stake looks like many independent raters. Mechanism: each rater binds a hardware-attested root H(tpm_ek||epoch||lane_id) and must produce a live ripple of two staggered nonce challenges from disjoint relays within 75 seconds. Cost: a reused EK hash forfeits 60% of bonded stake and freezes that lane for four epochs. Verification: relays publish EK fingerprints; peers discard clusters that share the same root. Failure: rented TPM farms or colluding relays collapse weight to zero.
